[h1]Fastranauts Performance Optimizer[/h1]

A non-breaking BepInEx performance and memory optimization mod for Ostranauts (v1.0.0.9+).

[h2]Key Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]PDA Status Overlays (P0):[/b] Eliminates the 24ms / 211KB periodic frame spike every 0.5s (and 30ms spike when paused at 16x speed) when PDA overlays are active.
[*][b]Pause & TimeScale (16x) Fix (P0):[/b] Fixes Unity Time.timeScale running PDAVisualisers, UI timers, and FixedUpdate 16x faster while paused, caches GUIOutput sprites, and fixes Rotor.Animate double Time.timeScale scaling.
[*][b]Update Decoupling & Sim Tick System (P0):[/b] Caps CrewSim.Update sub-stepping at high speeds, skips idle tickers in CrewSim.UpdateICOs without allocations, limits CondOwner visual/stat refreshes to once per rendered frame, and decouples epoch-based simulation Updates at 2x-16x speed.
[*][b]CrewSim & Raycast NonAlloc (P0):[/b] Replaces per-frame Physics.RaycastAll and LINQ OrderBy/ToArray allocations with zero-allocation Physics.RaycastNonAlloc buffers and fixes the CondOwner.Cleanup memory leak.
[*][b]Door Sensors & Atmosphere (P0):[/b] Eliminates per-tick List<CondOwner>, CondTrigger clone, and Condition object allocations in GasPressureSense, GasPump, and GasContainer.AddGasMols.
[*][b]2D Lighting & Visibility (P0):[/b] Eliminates per-frame List<T>, Segment, and Mesh.ToArray() allocations in Visibility light and LOS calculations.
[*][b]UI & Ground Inventory (P0):[/b] Throttles redundant per-frame 25-tile Ground inventory LOS scans while keeping drag-and-drop redraws instantaneous.
[*][b]Pathfinding & AI Radar (P1):[/b] Reuses JumpPointSearch 2D walkable grids, eliminates Vector2Int struct boxing in JPS/PathMemory, and rate-limits AI radar tracking scans.
[/list]

[h2]Mod Compatibility & Diagnostics[/h2]
Built using non-destructive Harmony Transpilers and isolated modules so it never conflicts with other mods (including Take Their Ships and JSON content mods). Press [code]F8[/code] or type [code]fastinfo[/code] in the console to view live telemetry.
